<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace __MODULE__\Application\UseCase\Command\__AREA__\__USE_CASE__;

use __MODULE__\Application\Port\Outbound\__REPOSITORY_PORT__;
use __MODULE__\Domain\Model\__AGGREGATE__\__AGGREGATE__;
use __MODULE__\Domain\ValueObject\{__AGGREGATE_ID_CLASS__, __SCOPE_ID_CLASS__, __ENUM_OR_VALUE_OBJECT_CLASS__};
use InvalidArgumentException;
use Shared\Application\Factory\UuidFactory;
use Shared\Application\Message\CommandHandler;
use Shared\Domain\Exception\InvalidValueException;
use ValueError;

/**
 * UseCase __HANDLER_CLASS__.
 *
 * @category UseCase
 *
 * @version 1.0.0
 *
 * @author __AUTHOR__
 */
final readonly class __HANDLER_CLASS__ implements CommandHandler
{
  // #region Constructor
  public function __construct(
    private __REPOSITORY_PORT__ $repository,
    private UuidFactory $uuidFactory,
  ) {
  }
  // #endregion

  // #region Methods
  /**
   * Method __invoke.
   *
   * Handles the corresponding use case execution.
   *
   * @since 1.0.0
   *
   * @param __COMMAND_CLASS__ $command the command payload
   *
   * @return __RESULT_CLASS__ the use case result
   */
  public function __invoke(__COMMAND_CLASS__ $command): __RESULT_CLASS__
  {
    try {
      $scopeId = __SCOPE_ID_CLASS__::fromString($command->__SCOPE_ID_PROPERTY__);

      /** @var __AGGREGATE_ID_CLASS__ $aggregateId */
      $aggregateId = $this->uuidFactory->create(__AGGREGATE_ID_CLASS__::class);

      $aggregate = __AGGREGATE__::create(
        id: $aggregateId,
        __SCOPE_ID_PROPERTY__: $scopeId,
        __FIELD_ONE_PROPERTY__: __ENUM_OR_VALUE_OBJECT_CLASS__::from($command->__FIELD_ONE_PROPERTY__),
        __FIELD_TWO_PROPERTY__: $command->__FIELD_TWO_PROPERTY__,
      );
    } catch (InvalidValueException|ValueError $exception) {
      throw new InvalidArgumentException($exception->getMessage(), 0, $exception);
    }

    $this->repository->save($aggregate);

    return new __RESULT_CLASS__(
      id: (string) $aggregate->id(),
      __SCOPE_ID_PROPERTY__: (string) $aggregate->__SCOPE_ID_ACCESSOR__(),
      __FIELD_ONE_PROPERTY__: $aggregate->__FIELD_ONE_ACCESSOR__()->value,
      __FIELD_TWO_PROPERTY__: $aggregate->__FIELD_TWO_ACCESSOR__(),
      createdAt: $aggregate->createdAt(),
      updatedAt: $aggregate->updatedAt(),
    );
  }

  // #endregion
}
